subject: POC trial RACI & success criteria - Clearlake Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial RACI & success criteria - Clearlake Health

Hi Sarah - great demo earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC scope and kickoff.

Recap:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for EHR summarization and search across a 1M-record test slice.
- Key constraints: redaction requirements, on-prem connector to Clearlake test environment, and SSO for testers.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: median generation latency < 350ms for 512-token prompts under trial load.
2) Quality: >85% accept rate on your annotation pass (we'll share evaluation set).
3) Reliability: <1% error rate and no client-impacting failures during business hours.
4) Integration: successful ingest and redaction over the provided dataset subset with clear audit logs.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Kickoff (technical onboarding & firewall allowlist): week of Jun 8.
- 4-week trial: Jun 8 - Jul 3.
- Weekly checkpoints (30m) + final evaluation & handoff.

Ownership (high level):
- Redwood: runtime, model variants, observability, POC SOW and support (Marissa / Aditya).
- Clearlake: test data slice, network access, internal stakeholder signoff, procurement.

I attached a draft POC SOW (POC_SOW_v1.pdf) - please review and confirm stakeholders + procurement contact so we can send for signature.

Next steps: confirm (1) trial dates, (2) Clearlake technical and procurement owners, and (3) any additional success metrics you want included.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0132
Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood

Thanks Sarah - appreciate the quick confirmation and the spreadsheet. Answers inline and an updated RACI at a glance below.

Infrastructure responsibilities:
- Redwood (we): provide a dedicated sandbox project on our hosted environment for the trial (isolated project, model variants pinned for the POC). Redwood will: deploy runtime, manage the model, provide logs and dashboards, and support integration.
- Clearlake (you): provide test dataset slice, network access (allowlist), and any on-prem connectors if you plan to run any traffic through your VPC.

Updated RACI (high level):
- Responsible: Aditya Rao (Redwood) - runtime setup, deployment, IPs, short-term troubleshooting.
- Accountable: Carlos Mendez (Clearlake) - data access and network approvals.
- Consulted: Rafael Gomez (Clearlake) - security checklist & redaction rules.
- Informed: Laura Bennett (Redwood CS) - onboarding, evaluation templates, and weekly sync facilitation.

Success criteria (refined):
- Latency: median < 350ms for 512-token prompts under a 5-concurrent-user sim load.
- Quality: >=85% match on your annotated eval set.
- Observability: access to per-request logs and token-level cost reports for the trial period.

Action items (owners):
- Redwood: send updated RACI & SOW for signature (Marissa) - attached raci_matrix.csv for your review.
- Redwood Eng: provide firewall IPs & SSO metadata (Aditya)
- Clearlake: confirm procurement contact and sign SOW.

I'll prepare the DocuSign link once you confirm the procurement email.

Marissa

On Fri, May 29, 2026 at 09:20 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Updated RACI (high level):
> - Responsible: Aditya Rao (Redwood) - runtime setup, deployment, IPs, short-term troubleshooting.

Thanks - quick technical notes from my side to keep the kickoff smooth:
- We will provision a dedicated sandbox project on our hosted infra (isolated tenancy). No customer-side VMs required unless you want the VPC connector.
- Required from Clearlake before kickoff:
  - A test user account with SSO metadata (SAML) or a set of 3 test users (email + role) we can seed.
  - IP allowlist entries: 52.12.34.101, 52.12.34.102 (Redwood egress for sandbox).
  - Sample data slice: anonymized 10k record CSV (dropbox/drive link is fine).
- Proposed runtime config for trial: 2x T4-equivalent instances, 8GB KV cache, model quantized to INT8 for cost/eval balance. If you expect high concurrency we can bump to 4x.

Action items (technical):
- Aditya: provision sandbox + share SSO metadata & allowlist IPs (by Jun 4).
- Clearlake: provide SSO metadata, test accounts, and sample dataset (by Jun 4).
- Marissa/Laura: schedule weekly 30m check-ins (first one Jun 10).

I've attached a quick RACI export (raci_matrix.csv) that mirrors Marissa's note. Happy to jump on a 15-30m call during setup week if you want a runthrough.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
